name: Partnership Leaders Research
description: Partnership Leaders Research helps partnership teams query curated partner ecosystem research across systems integrators, AI partnerships, cybersecurity, revenue technology, data infrastructure, digital agencies, marketplaces, partner programs, and ecosystem company signals. The connector is designed for senior partnership leaders who need source-grounded answers, company-specific research, ecosystem scans, and concise briefs backed by named companies, dates, figures, and retrieved findings. _published_faq.name: How do I add Partnership Leaders Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Partnership Leaders Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://si-research-dashboard-production-25d8.up.railway.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Partnership Leaders Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partnership Leaders Research provides these MCP tools: answer_and_evaluate_research_question, answer_research_question, evaluate_research_answer, get_finding, list_companies, list_events, list_tags, and search_findings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Partnership Leaders Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Partnership Leaders Research in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Partnership Leaders Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partnership Leaders Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Partnership Leaders Research is developed by Partnership Leaders. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
